name: Dörnberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, black and yellow in the proportions 1:2:1, the black charged at the top with the yellow urn of the municipal arms of Dörnberg.
history: Municipal flag of Dörnberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
